headline: Argentina Launches Citizenship Scheme to Attract Foreign Property Investors
summary: Argentina introduced a new investment-for-citizenship program, featuring routes such as a USD 350,000 non-refundable contribution to the National Treasury, aimed at attracting wealthy investors from regions including mainland China and Hong Kong.
why: Residency and citizenship-by-investment programs are utilized by developing economies to attract foreign capital inflows and stimulate local real estate or economic development.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Investment-for-citizenship schemes aim to generate capital inflows for the national treasury.
